title: Titles in Engineering
statementMd:
In Engineering (`department_id = 1`), how many employees hold each title?

Expected columns: `title`, `n`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS n FROM employees WHERE department_id = 1 GROUP BY title;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
